ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixels to 15% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels on the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity patches located exclusively at the distal tips of both lobes; central and proximal regions are dominated by solid low-intensity pixels with moderate mottling at the transition zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped indentation dividing the fluke into two symmetrical lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-level amplitude variations (jagged peaks) distributed along the entire trailing edge from notch to tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave upward curve originating from the median notch and terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast light pixel groups located at the extreme peripheral tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified bio-fouling and barnacle colonization localized at the distal ends of both lobes.
